Label_Event_Lottery_DrawMethod_Content:
# Draw Method
Three tickets will be randomly selected as the top 3 prizes. These three tickets will remain for the final stage of the draw and will not participate in the draws for consolation and small prizes category.

# Exclude ticket after winning
If a member's ticket is drawn, all other tickets held by the member will be disqualified from further draws, ensuring each member can only win once.

# Lottery Draw
The draw sequence is as follows: the first 10 winners will be selected from the consolation prize category, followed by 20 winners from the small prize category. The three tickets previously reserved for the 3rd prize, 1st prize, and 2nd prize will be drawn. Lastly the Zodiac draw will take place.

# Remaining Tickets
All remaining tickets will become invalid after the event ends and cannot be carried forward to next events.

# Prize Distribution
All prizes will be credited to the winner's Nova88 accounts within 24 hours (GMT+8) after the draw ends and can be withdrawn directly without any turnover requirements.
Label_Event_Lottery_EventParticipation_C:
# Game Objective
The Lottery Event is an exciting lottery activity crafted for active members to win a variety of prizes. The more you bet, the greater your chance of winning higher prizes. Members can also purchase Zodiac sticker for a chance to win the Jackpot!

# How to Participate
Members will automatically participate in the event with the lottery tickets they receive during event period. The lucky numbers of the tickets can be checked on the event page.

# How to get Lottery Tickets
For every MYR 1,188 in accumulated valid bets, members will receive one lottery ticket with a randomly assigned number. The tickets will be distributed within 24 hours on the following day.

# Betting Amount Calculation and Drawing Time
Valid betting amounts will be calculated from 00:00:00 (GMT+8) on the first day of each two-week lottery period until 23:59:59 (GMT+8) on the day before the drawing. The drawing will take place at 20:00 (GMT+8) on the Monday following the end of each two-week period.

Accumulation of valid bets occurs from January 1, 2024, to January 14, 2024.
The lottery drawing for this period will take place on January 15, 2024, at 20:00 (GMT+8).
